title: Japanese-Style Grilled Fish Skewers
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired dish perfect for a quick dinner. The combination of sweet and savory flavors from the soy sauce and sesame oil pairs well with the smoky taste of the grilled fish.
instructions: 2. In a medium bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, brown sugar, ginger, and Korean chili flakes (if using).
3. Add the salmon pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly.
4. Thread the marinated salmon pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the fish is cooked through and slightly charred.
6. Serve immediately, garnished with green onions and a squeeze of lime juice.
